Programa de Modernizacin del Poder Judicial del Estado de Cear (PROMOJUD)

description.narrative: Avanzar en la implementacin de la transformacin digital del Poder Judicial de Cear para incrementar su eficiencia y la satisfaccin de los usuarios. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) mejorar la productividad en la prestacin de servicios del TJCE; y (ii) mejorar la efectividad en la gestin del TJCE.

Modernize the State of Cearas Judiciary Branch through strengthening its governance and management, and through digital transformation, as mechanisms to improve institutional performance and to enhance public service delivery both quantitatively and qualitatively. Advance in the implementation of the digital transformation of the Judicial Power of Cear to increase its efficiency and user satisfaction. The specific objectives are: (i) to improve productivity in the provision of services of the CJEC; and (ii) to improve the effectiveness in the management of the CJEC
